Senses.Explanation: An adept is a real hand whose competence is tested or credited in the role named by the context. Chan records apply the word to masters, battle-generals, guests, and poets, while public exchanges ask directly who is an adept or reject someone as not one. It modifies an adept master (作家宗師), an adept battle-general (作家戰將), and an adept Chan guest (作家禪客); an adepts' meeting (作家相見) names a meeting of people credited with that competence, while the doubled exclamation 'a real hand! a real hand!' (作家作家) praises it. The public interview can ask directly, 'What is an adept?' (如何是作家), and Qingping Weikuang dismisses a monk with the negative verdict, 'Not an adept—out!' (不是作家出去). One transmitted exchange applies the same adjective to 'an accomplished poet' (作家詩客). Poet and Chan master are different roles, but the headword contributes the same expert status in each; the corpus does not establish a separate modern 'author' or 'writer' sense.
Senses.Note: One corpus-wide expert/adept sense is retained after the item-8 family test. The poet phrase occurs in seven allowlisted files, but all seven transmit the same Dayu Zhi encounter; no productive reversed or related poet family was found. Expert poet (作家詩客), adept master (作家宗師), adept battle-general (作家戰將), and adept Chan guest (作家禪客) are applications of one accomplished-person meaning, not different things. Allowlist count: 2,744 hits in 331 texts. Productive families include adepts' meeting (作家相見), 117; an adept's means (作家手段), 34; doubled praise (作家作家), 22; adept fellow (作家漢), 14; adept eye (作家眼), 10; and adept forge (作家爐韛), 4. The modern default 'author/writer' is unsupported.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄). Yuanwu Keqin's prose commentary (評唱) on the Yunmen case, (碧巖錄) case 15. 'This monk is quite the adept.'

Occurrences.Kwic: 大凡作家宗師。要與人解粘去縛。抽釘拔楔。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Exact actor: Yuanwu Keqin. Source text (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄). Yuanwu's commentary: 'Generally an adept master unsticks and unbinds people, pulls out nails and draws out wedges.' Defines the role-word (作家宗師).

Occurrences.Kwic: 爾若要作家相見。便與爾作家相見。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Exact actor: Yuanwu Keqin. Source text (佛果圜悟禪師碧巖錄). Yuanwu on Changsha/Yangshan: 'If you want an adepts' meeting, I'll give you an adepts' meeting.' The collocation (作家相見).

Occurrences.Kwic: 師乃掩耳而已。居士云。作家作家。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: (景德傳燈錄), (石林和尚) section: Layman Pang (龐居士 = Pang Yun) exclaims '(作家作家)!' ('a real hand! a real hand!') in praise of Shilin. Speaker is Pang, verified from the (石林和尚) head + running (居士云).

Occurrences.Kwic: 若是作家戰將。便請單刀直入。更莫如何若何。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source text (景德傳燈錄). Quoted (示眾) of (興化和尚) (Xinghua Cunjiang) inside the (廬州澄心院旻德和尚) section: 'If you are an adept battle-general, come straight in single-blade — no more of your what-ifs.' (作家戰將) = an adept of real skill.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Faxi Yin (法璽印禪師語錄): during the retreat-opening hall exchange, an unnamed monk says that forging buddhas and patriarchs requires an adept and asks Faxi Yin what an adept is; Faxi answers 'one who kills without blinking.' Occurrences.Kwic: 時有僧出礼拜師云不是作家出去
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Transmission of the Lamp, Jade Flowers Collection, fragment (傳燈玉英集（殘卷）): the section heading names Qingping Weikuang; after a monk steps out and bows during Qingping's hall address, Qingping says he is not an adept and sends him out.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師曰。路逢劍客須呈劍。不是詩人不獻詩。曰作家詩客。師曰。一條紅線兩人牽。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Continued Record of the Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄): inside Fahua Quanju's biography, Dayu Shouzhi is the exact interlocutor denoted by 'the fool' (愚), who appraises Quanju as an accomplished poet before Quanju answers with the red-thread line.

Occurrences.Kwic: 若無本分作家手段，未免賺悞方來
